primary_question: Does the existing packed + TiKV design reduce the complete cost of fanout from a large immutable base into multiple retained writable workspaces?
runtime: Current main 9832ddd only. No experimental transaction optimizer.
method: Each cell creates four new workspaces. Prior workspaces are retained, as in a persistent multi-workspace deployment. The three operational rounds share one published base and are paired rounds, not three independent fresh deployments.
primary_total: Preparation measured once plus the sum of every actually executed four-workspace lifecycle at the size point. Include the 1M capacity-pilot lifecycle in this end-to-end total; exclude it only from the separate three-round operational summary.
reporting: Show preparation, sum of workspace lifecycle costs, complete total and per-workspace amortized cost for both arms. Keep all paired round samples. Do not present a cross-size scaling trend because the total fanout counts differ.
timing: Every lifecycle includes mount/bootstrap, native clone where applicable, prewarm, reads, COW with fsync, final remote drain, unmount and process exit. Correctness verification and common synthetic input generation are separate and explicitly reported.
scope: One deployment scenario, two size points, one fixed upload mode and one default frame geometry. No additional scan/read-only/bulk-write scenes are part of the focused comparison.
